title: The Goodbye That Waited for the Second Wave
youtube_title: The Goodbye That Waited for the Second Wave | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Ilaria is just outside the fun, close to a goodbye that waited so two waves could happen. Delia changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Ilaria has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
